name: Utimutiraja’s Upeh household
goals: Keep provisions moving without treating a safeguard as a pledge of allegiance.
Preserve the household’s contacts after its headman’s execution.
bio: The household can find rice, carriers or someone to bring a petition. A promise from Utimutiraja does not bind his son, and his widow pursues her own course after his death.
notes: fact: The Commentaries describes Utimutiraja seeking protection while supplying labour to the king, and his widow enlisting Kadir after the executions (Birch III, pp. 109–110, 149–152)
gameplay: Jaka and the reception broker supply fictional patron links; the household does not stand for every resident of Upeh (people-factions.md §§3–4)
